description: This file defines the UpdateUI class which provides static methods for determining weather icon identifiers based on weather conditions and times, as well as translating day names into localized strings within an Android weather application.

classes.name: UpdateUI
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for UI updates related to weather conditions and day translations.

methods.name: getIconID
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the weather icon based on weather condition code and time parameters.

methods.name: TranslateDay
methods.description: Translates a day name into a localized string resource based on the provided context.
